name: Draft comprehensive safety dossier
description: Compile technical specifications, risk mitigation strategies, and operational protocols into a formal document to present to potential insurance underwriters.

name: Identify and contact specialty brokers
description: Research and reach out to aviation insurance brokers specializing in autonomous systems and recreational liability to request quotes.

name: Review and negotiate policy terms
description: Analyze quotes for coverage limits and exclusion clauses, consulting with legal counsel to ensure the policy adequately covers autonomous drone-human interaction.

name: Draft comprehensive operational safety case
description: Compile technical specifications, flight parameters, and risk mitigation strategies into a formal document for FSDO review.

name: Conduct third-party safety audit
description: Engage an external auditor to verify that all documentation and proposed safety protocols meet FAA and FSDO standards.

name: Submit and present to FSDO
description: Formally file the safety case and attend the pre-application meeting to address regulatory inquiries and secure preliminary approval.

name: Consult local land-use attorney
description: Engage a specialized land-use attorney to conduct a preliminary audit of zoning codes and identify potential regulatory hurdles for a recreational drone facility.

name: Prepare zoning and permit applications
description: Compile all necessary site plans, safety documentation, and environmental impact statements required for municipal zoning and recreational facility permit submissions.

name: Engage neighborhood councils
description: Initiate proactive communication with local neighborhood councils to present the project, address noise and privacy concerns, and build community support prior to formal hearings.

name: Attend municipal zoning hearings
description: Represent the project at public municipal hearings to present the safety case and secure final approval for land-use and facility operation.

name: Conduct comprehensive site engineering audit
description: Perform a detailed structural and electrical assessment of the chosen facility to ensure it can support high-density drone charging, network equipment, and modular obstacle weight loads.

name: Finalize lease and utility upgrade agreements
description: Negotiate and sign the facility lease, including specific clauses for necessary utility upgrades and infrastructure modifications required for the arena.

name: Execute facility site preparation and cleanup
description: Clear the space, perform necessary repairs, and install the required power and data infrastructure to prepare for the modular construction phase.

name: Source high-impact safety netting
description: Identify and procure industrial-grade, high-impact netting materials that meet recreational combat safety standards and fire codes.

name: Review containment design with officials
description: Conduct a formal pre-installation review of the containment barrier blueprints with local building inspectors to ensure full code compliance.

name: Install netting and physical barriers
description: Execute the physical installation of perimeter safety netting and structural barriers within the arena to ensure a secure flight environment.

name: Perform final safety containment audit
description: Conduct a rigorous stress test and inspection of all installed netting and barriers to verify they meet all safety and regulatory requirements.

name: Conduct site RF spectrum analysis
description: Perform a comprehensive sweep of the target facility to identify existing signal interference and map RF propagation patterns in the presence of urban-mimicry obstacles.

name: Design private network topology
description: Develop the architecture for the private 5G/CBRS network, ensuring optimal placement of small cells and gateways to guarantee sub-20ms latency across the entire arena.

name: Procure and install network hardware
description: Purchase and physically install the CBRS radio units, core network controllers, and signal distribution equipment within the arena perimeter.

name: Validate network performance and latency
description: Conduct stress tests under simulated load to verify that the network maintains consistent sub-20ms latency and zero packet loss during high-density drone operations.

name: Define technical specifications and requirements
description: Establish precise performance metrics, payload capacities, and durability standards for the industrial-grade drone fleet to ensure they meet the operational demands of the combat arena.

name: Identify and vet global suppliers
description: Research and qualify multiple manufacturers capable of providing industrial-grade drones and spare parts, ensuring they can meet volume requirements and delivery timelines.

name: Execute procurement and logistics
description: Place formal orders for the primary fleet and spare components, manage import/export compliance, and track shipments to ensure arrival within the project timeline.

name: Perform hardware inspection and testing
description: Conduct rigorous quality control checks upon arrival, including flight testing and component stress tests, to verify all units meet safety and performance standards.

name: Develop core flight and AI logic
description: Architect the semi-autonomous engagement algorithms, including obstacle avoidance, target tracking, and flight path optimization within the simulation environment.

name: Implement geofencing and safety protocols
description: Program hard-coded geofencing boundaries and emergency kill-switch triggers to ensure drones remain within the designated arena and respond instantly to safety overrides.

name: Conduct bench and simulation testing
description: Perform rigorous unit testing and simulated flight stress tests to validate logic stability, latency response, and geofence reliability before field deployment.

name: Prototype Haptic and Kill Switch Integration
description: Develop a proof-of-concept bench test connecting the wearable haptic vests to the drone telemetry stream to ensure zero-latency signal transmission and reliable emergency override functionality.

name: Validate Safety Kill Switch Reliability
description: Conduct rigorous stress testing of the hardware-level kill switches to ensure they maintain priority override control even during software-level communication failures or high-latency events.

name: Integrate Haptic Feedback with Flight Logic
description: Finalize the software integration between the autonomous engagement AI and the haptic vests to ensure accurate, real-time feedback for players during simulated combat interactions.

name: Analyze market and competitor pricing
description: Conduct comprehensive research on local entertainment venues and corporate team-building pricing models to establish a competitive yet profitable baseline for HVT memberships.

name: Draft tiered membership and corporate packages
description: Design the structure for individual memberships and corporate partnership tiers, including benefits, pricing, and service level agreements.

name: Validate pricing with corporate stakeholders
description: Present proposed packages to a focus group of potential corporate clients to gather feedback and refine the offering before final implementation.

name: Develop safety and operational manuals
description: Draft comprehensive standard operating procedures (SOPs) covering drone flight safety, emergency kill-switch protocols, and range management guidelines.

name: Recruit and onboard range staff
description: Source and hire personnel with drone technical expertise and safety management backgrounds, ensuring all staff meet the required certification standards.

name: Conduct staff certification workshops
description: Execute hands-on training sessions for all staff, focusing on emergency response, drone maintenance, and customer safety protocols.

name: Perform final operational readiness drills
description: Run full-scale simulation drills to verify that staff can effectively manage the range and respond to simulated emergency scenarios.

name: Design beta testing protocols
description: Develop structured test scripts and safety checklists for controlled user groups to evaluate system performance and identify software bugs.

name: Execute controlled user beta sessions
description: Run live stress tests with small, monitored groups to gather performance data and user feedback on the simulation experience.

name: Perform rapid system patches and calibration
description: Analyze beta session data to perform immediate software patches, hardware recalibrations, and safety system adjustments.

name: Validate final performance metrics
description: Verify that the system meets all safety and operational benchmarks required for the full public launch.
